name: Create ticket (layout per department, templates, quick create)
pre: Signed in as Owner. Department Marketing (no SLA, no rule). Contact "QA MAN Contact 1" (create it in Contacts first, email = QA mailbox M1). Known: NDC-2661 (screen create said "Permission denied").
why: Every ticket starts here. NDC agents type phone and chat tickets by hand (54 % + 33 % of their volume).

cases.title: Create a phone ticket from the screen
steps: Subject "QA MAN phone 01", Contact = QA MAN Contact 1, Channel = Phone, no priority.
cases.exp: Success message (not "Permission denied"). Ticket page opens with a new ticket number. Channel shows Phone. Status is the default open status.

cases.title: Create a chat ticket typed by an agent
steps: Subject "QA MAN chat 01", Channel = Chat, contact QA MAN Contact 1.
cases.exp: Ticket created in Customer Support, owner rules as configured, channel Chat. Agent C can open it.

cases.title: Required fields are enforced
steps: Then clear Department (if possible) and Save.
cases.exp: Save is blocked. Each missing field shows an inline message. No ticket is created (check All Tickets).

cases.title: Very long and special-character subject
steps: Create a ticket with a 255-character subject that starts "QA MAN long" and contains Arabic, emoji and x.
cases.exp: 255 chars saves and shows as plain text (no bold, no script). 1,000 chars is refused with a clear limit message, or saved in full — record which. No "unexpected error".

cases.title: Layout follows the department
steps: Switch department to Tech (or a QA NDC department with its own layout).
cases.exp: The form changes to that department's layout. Values already typed in shared fields stay.

cases.title: Create from a ticket template
steps: Create template "QA MAN template" in Settings › Tickets › Templates (subject + priority Low).
cases.exp: Fields are pre-filled from the template. Ticket saves with those values.

cases.title: Ticket survives reload and sign-in
steps: Sign out, sign in again, search the ticket number.
cases.exp: All values are the same as saved.

cases.title: Agent cannot create in a department he is not in
steps: Sign in as Agent C (Customer Support only).
cases.exp: Only his departments are offered. He cannot save a ticket into Marketing.

cases.title: Create form in Arabic
steps: Switch the header language to Arabic.
cases.exp: Labels and buttons in Arabic, form right-to-left, no raw keys like desk.tickets.x, success message in Arabic.

cases.title: Tenant workflow side effects
steps: After T-04-01, open the ticket's Activity / History.
Check Activities and Tags for new items.
cases.exp: Note any task, tag or call that a tenant-wide workflow rule added. With no priority and channel Phone, none should appear. Record and clean any.

name: Ticket detail: properties, conversation, history, tabs, pins
pre: Ticket "QA MAN phone 01". Known: NDC-2660 (history raw ids); candidate "Followers was updated" shows raw user ids.
why: Agents live on this page all day.

cases.title: Page parts load
steps: Click each tab: Conversation, Resolution, Time, Attachment, Parent-Child, Activity, Approval, History.
cases.exp: Header (subject, status, Reply, Comment, Close) and properties panel show. Every tab opens without error or raw keys.

cases.title: Edit properties inline
steps: Change Subject to "QA MAN phone 01 edited".
cases.exp: Each change saves on its own. A success toast shows.

cases.title: History records each change with names
cases.exp: Create, subject, due date and priority changes are listed with the user's name and old → new values. No raw ids or arrays.

cases.title: Due date in the past
cases.exp: Refused with a message, or saved and the ticket marked overdue — record which. No crash.

cases.title: Unknown ticket link
steps: Change the last 4 characters of the id.
cases.exp: "Not found" page. No data from another ticket.

cases.title: Two people edit at once
steps: Open the ticket in two browsers (Owner and Admin B).
Owner, without reload, changes priority to Low.
cases.exp: The second save is refused with a "changed by someone else" message, or the last one wins and History shows both. Record which.

cases.title: Values kept after reload
cases.exp: Edited subject, due date, priority are still there.

cases.title: Agent outside the department
cases.exp: Access refused / not found. No properties or conversation shown.

cases.title: Detail page in Arabic
steps: Tab through the header buttons with the keyboard.
cases.exp: Labels in Arabic, layout mirrored, dates readable, focus order follows the visual order.

name: Reply, reply all, forward, CC/BCC, signatures, send as email
partly: Ticket replies run 26 Oct (docs/desk-ticket-replies). Focus here on NDC-Staging, CC/BCC, signature, real delivery.
pre: Ticket "QA MAN reply 01" on contact QA MAN Contact 1 (mailbox M1). Second mailbox M2 for CC/forward. Signature set in My profile. Known: NDC-2636, NDC-2377.
why: The customer only sees what goes out by email.

cases.title: Reply reaches the customer
cases.exp: Reply shows in the thread as outgoing. Email arrives in M1 from the support address, subject has the ticket number.

cases.title: Reply all with CC and BCC
steps: Add CC = M2, BCC = M2 alias (or a 3rd mailbox).
cases.exp: M1 gets it, CC gets it, BCC gets it but is not visible to others. Thread shows CC.

cases.title: Forward
steps: Forward the first message to M2 with a note.
cases.exp: M2 receives the forward with the original text. Thread marks it as a forward.

cases.title: Invalid address and empty body
cases.exp: Both refused with a clear message. Nothing is saved as "sent".

cases.title: Signature is added
steps: Set a signature in My profile.
cases.exp: Signature is inserted once, under the text. Arabic signature keeps RTL.

cases.title: Long reply with paste from Word
steps: Paste a 3-page text with a table and an image.
cases.exp: Sent. Formatting is kept or cleanly simplified. Email in M1 is readable.

cases.title: Customer replies back
cases.exp: Customer reply is threaded on the same ticket (not a new ticket). Status follows the rule (for example back to Open).

cases.title: Sent reply kept after reload
cases.exp: Replies, CC and forward stay in the thread, in time order.

cases.title: Agent without reply right
steps: Share a Marketing ticket read-only with Customer Support.
cases.exp: Reply and Forward are hidden or refused.

cases.title: Arabic reply
cases.exp: Composer is RTL for Arabic text. Email in M1 shows Arabic correctly (no "????").

cases.title: Private comment

cases.title: Edit and delete own comment
cases.exp: Edit shows "edited". Delete removes it after a confirm.

cases.title: Mention an agent
cases.exp: Mention chip shows. B gets a bell notification that opens the ticket.

cases.title: Empty comment and script text
cases.exp: Empty refused. Script does not run; text is shown safely.

cases.title: Public comment visibility
steps: Add a comment with visibility Public (if offered).
Open the ticket on the Help Center as the contact.
cases.exp: Public comment visible to the customer; private ones never.

cases.title: Pin a comment
cases.exp: Pinned block shows on top after reload; gone after unpin.

cases.title: Another agent cannot edit my comment
steps: Try to edit the Owner's comment.
cases.exp: Edit/delete hidden or refused (unless B's profile allows).

cases.title: Draft does not leak into comment
steps: Press Shift+C or the comment icon.
cases.exp: Comment editor opens empty (candidate bug: draft pre-fills it).

cases.title: Comment in Arabic
steps: Add an Arabic comment with a mention.
cases.exp: RTL text, mention chip placed right, no broken order.

cases.title: Comment kept after reload
cases.exp: Comment, visibility and pin state unchanged.

Both click Pick up within 2 seconds.

cases.title: Agent cannot reassign without right

cases.exp: Allowed or hidden exactly as the Desk Agent profile says (check the profile first).

cases.title: Owner picker in Arabic
steps: Open Owner picker and search an Arabic name.

name: Status, priority, due date, on hold, close / reopen

cases.title: Full status flow
cases.exp: Each change saved. Closed badge shows. Reopen sets an open status. History lists all.

cases.title: Close dialog options

cases.title: Priority Low/Medium change
cases.exp: Saved. List shows the new priority.

cases.title: Close a ticket that needs a mandatory field

cases.exp: Close blocked with a message naming the field.

cases.title: Customer reply on a closed ticket
steps: Reply from M1 to the last email.
cases.exp: Ticket reopens, or a new ticket is made — as the department setting says. Record which.

cases.title: Status after reload

cases.exp: Ticket shows in the right view.

cases.title: Agent close permission

cases.title: Status names in Arabic
cases.exp: Status names translated or shown as entered; close dialog RTL.

cases.exp: Rows change order correctly (check first and last row).

cases.title: Star, clone and delete a view

cases.title: View, sort and star kept
cases.exp: Starred view, last sort and columns kept.

Agent C opens it and tries edit/delete.

cases.title: Views in Arabic
